root_cause.text: The error path in `io_zcrx_map_area()` fails to DMA-unmap the scatter-gather table when `io_populate_area_dma()` fails, because the `is_mapped` flag is only set on success, but the table was already mapped before the call, leading to a resource leak.
root_cause.evidence: CVE description states "io_zcrx_map_area() will have an initialised and not freed table. It was supposed to be cleaned up in the error path, but !is_mapped prevents that." The patch adds `dma_unmap_sgtable()` in the failure case when `!area->mem.is_dmabuf`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing DMA unmapping on failure of io_populate_area_dma for non-dmabuf areas.
intent_record.what: Added conditional dma_unmap_sgtable call when io_populate_area_dma fails and area is not a dmabuf.
intent_record.how: Ensures that DMA mappings are properly released on error path, preventing resource leak.

candidates.rationale: This condition gates the setting of is_mapped flag only on success, so on failure the flag remains false, and later cleanup code that checks the flag will not unmap the scatter-gather table, causing a DMA resource leak.

This assignment only occurs when ret == 0, leaving is_mapped false on failure. Since the table was already mapped before io_populate_area_dma, the error path relies on is_mapped to decide whether to unmap, leading to a leak.

This return exits without any call to DMA-unmap the scatter-gather table when io_populate_area_dma fails, because the is_mapped flag was not set, so no unmapping is performed, resulting in a resource leak.
